compos.text: A smartphone screen displaying a meditation app. The top section shows the title "Day 1 - Meditation: Life's Most Pow..." and the subtitle "Free to Love." Below the title, there are three tabs labeled "Playlist," "Details," and "Journal," with the "Journal" tab selected. The journal section contains questions and responses, including "What has led you to participate in this meditation series?" with the response "I've decided to try improving my lifestyle," and "Are you willing to meditate every day?" with the response "Yes!" The background is a gradient of purple shades.

"Instructions for editing a journal entry: 'Edit your Journal by clicking on the pencil icon next to the reflection question. Make sure you click "save" when you are done writing! All edits will also be synced to the web version of your Journal.'"
Button with the text "PREVIOUS" indicating a navigation option to go to the previous page or step.
A purple button with the text "GOT IT" in white, indicating user acknowledgment or confirmation.
Alt text: "Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a "Getting Started" guide for a journaling app. The main content includes:

1. **Title**: "Getting Started" at the top.
2. **Image**: A visual representation of a smartphone screen showing the journal interface.
3. **Section Title**: "Journal".
4. **Instructions**: Detailed steps on how to edit the journal by clicking on the pencil icon next to reflection questions, and a reminder to click "save" after writing. It also mentions that all edits will sync with the web version of the journal.
5. **Navigation Buttons**: At the bottom, there are two buttons - "PREVIOUS" on the left and "GOT IT" on the right, allowing the user to navigate through the guide.

The screen is designed to help users understand how to use the journaling feature of the app effectively.
